(308193) 2005 CB
79
is a
trans-Neptunian object
that is a member of the
Haumea family
.
[
9
]
Haumea family
As a member of the Haumea family,
2005 CB
79
is suspected of being an icy mantle collisional fragment from the
dwarf planet
Haumea
.  With an
absolute magnitude
(H) of 4.7,
[
4
]
and a Haumea family
albedo
of 0.7, this object would have a diameter of 158 km.
[
7
]
Observations by
Mike Brown
in 2012 using the
W. M. Keck Observatory
suggest that
2005 CB
79
does not have a
companion
.
[
11
]
